messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap — POC success criteria & proposed onramp

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the kickoff. Great discovery; captured the items we agreed on and a suggested timeline below.

Top-line success criteria (proposed):
- Ingestion: Redwood runs NLU extraction on a representative 500K-row sample with >92% label fidelity vs your golden set.
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency < 300ms for typical short queries in hosted mode (demo workload).
- Integration: Seamless API integration with your search pipeline using the preview endpoints.
- Security: Data residency and logging controls verified against your compliance checklist (see items below).

Proposed POC onramp (4 weeks):
1) Kickoff & access (week 0): confirm stakeholders, cloud creds for isolated test env, calendar invite for Mar 3 — 60m.
2) Environment & sample load (week 1): ingest sample data, verify schema mapping.
3) Model tuning & guardrails (week 2): run evaluation slices, iterate prompts / quantization profiles.
4) Integration sprint & acceptance (week 3): embed APIs in your pipeline, run acceptance tests and readout.

Ownership (proposed):
- Redwood: Diego (AM, project lead), Karthik (SE, infra & integration).
- Clymb: Lena (product lead), Tom (infra).

Ask from you: confirm stakeholders (include legal/security if you want SOC2 evidence), and confirm the kickoff slot — we were thinking week of Mar 1; available options: Tue Mar 2 or Wed Mar 3 morning PT.

Attachments: POC-success-metrics.xlsx (metrics spreadsheet with test cases).

Thanks — I’ll wait for confirmation and will push a calendar invite once we lock the kickoff.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clymb.ai>

Date: 2026-02-16T12:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — POC success criteria & proposed onramp

Diego — thanks for the clear recap. Quick notes from our side after reviewing with Tom:
- Compliance: we need logs retained for 14 days and an automated PII redaction step for user transcripts. Please confirm whether the hosted demo endpoints support configurable retention and redaction, or if we should plan for a private deployment during the POC.
- Security evidence: can you share a short SOC2 summary (scope & date)? Our infosec will want that before we spin up anything in our environment.
- Stakeholders: please add Priya Malhotra (Head of Ops) to the thread — she’s final approver for trial contracts.

We’re leaning toward the Wed Mar 3 kickoff at 9am PT if that works. I’ll confirm after looping in Priya.

Thanks,
Lena
Product Lead, Clymb.ai

Lena / Priya / Tom — looping Priya in as requested. Short answers and an updated plan below.

Compliance & retention:
- Hosted preview endpoints: support configurable retention windows and a server-side redaction pipeline we can enable for the trial (configurable to 0/7/14/30 days). For strict separation we can provision a private dedicated instance for the POC — both options are possible; I’ve noted tradeoffs in the attachment.
- SOC2: attaching SOC2-summary.pdf (high level; cert dated 2025-11).

Revised onramp timeline & checklist (4-week view):
- Kickoff (Mar 3): confirm access, runbook review, calendar invites.
- Week 1: Test env + sample load (tasks: S3 bucket mapping, sample ingestion, schema check). Owner: Karthik + Tom.
- Week 2: Baseline runs & tuning (tasks: prompt tuning, quantization profile tests, evaluation slices). Owner: Redwood ML team (Karthik lead).
- Week 3: Integration & acceptance tests (tasks: API embed, latency runs, end-to-end readout). Owner: Diego + Marissa (CS).
- Final readout (end of week 3): short demo + decision checkpoint.

Cadence: weekly 30m sync (Tuesdays) + ad-hoc Slack channel. Karthik can lead technical calls.

Action items for Clymb before kickoff:
- Share a 500K-row representative CSV (or S3 path) by Fri Feb 20.
- Provide a security contact for any onboarding forms.

I’ll send a calendar invite for Mar 3 09:00 PT if that slot is still good. Also linking the trial SOW for signature: https://app.docusign.com/EXAMPLE-TRIAL-SOW-4821

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf; POC-success-metrics.xlsx (updated).
